lines: Whoa, the tunnel here is a lot bigger!!
After running for a while, we had arrived at a tunnel much wider than before.
There were bigger shafts branching off the tunnel here and there, and the light shining in from above ground was dazzling.
It was most likely the ruins of a subway tunnel, planned when Tokyo Kingdom was built, but aborted during construction.
It was said that the cancellation of the subway system was the reason for Tokyo Kingdom's quick downfall.
(If that's the case, the exit above ground should be just up ahead.)
Yeah, we should be able to get above ground up ahead.
Uwaaaahh... mommy, granny, looks like the Uehara bloodline will not end just yet...
Stop overreacting. It was all thanks to that steel lady taking care of those ants that were guarding the exit though...
I jumped back upon hearing Hebiko's voice and a round shadow appeared in the spot where I had just been standing, steadily getting bigger, andー
What had landed was a black chunk of steel with limbs. It creaked loudly while getting back on its feet.
C'mon!! What the hell is it this time!?!
No, this is a powered exoskeleton... it's like a walking tank!
In other words, there had to be a human inside this thing...
The powered exoskeleton aimed the gun on its right arm in our direction.
The ultrafast bullets easily bent the rail I had been standing on only a moment ago.
(It wasn't the ants who were guarding the exit... it was this thing!)
Fuma-chan!! How would you defeat it!? Not even Hebiko's tentacles can block those bullets!!
That thing has composite armor like a tank, you think we can beat it!?
Isn't that all we've been doing anyways!?
It's not like we can help it!!! And running away is an important tactic too.
Listen, this thing has tank-grade armor and firepower, but what it lacks is speed.
That's because of its weight. In the end that means running away is the best strategy here, got it?!
Accompanied by the sound of metallic clanking, the mechanical ants from earlier appeared from the tunnel.
There's still some of them left... Shit!!
In front of us, weaponized black steel. Behind us, a swarm of mechanical ants.
(And we had barely managed to escape thanks to Asukaー)
(No, there were simply too many. There were probably some that dodged Asuka's bullets and slipped through.)
We were trapped once more. While I was still thinking about our situation, the mouth of the powered exoskeleton's gun was pointed at us again.
(Is it going to turn us into minced meat together with the ants...!)
For a second, I thought I had seen a shadow pass over the powered exoskeleton's head.
And moments later, a white figure emerged from the shaft above it.
With her hair fluttering wildly, she swung her greataxeー
In one wide arc! And slammed it right into the armor of the powered exoskeleton.
The powered exoskeleton turned its head to look back, seemingly unable to comprehend what had happened. The pilot inside appeared to be perplexed.
It's all just for show, huh. Here I go!!!
Swinging her greataxe as easily as a twig, she was launching attack after attack.
She was like a high-spirited taiko drummer.
Her attacks were getting faster and faster, and only the light reflected by her greataxe could be seen.
Having lifted the powered exoskeleton into the air with her attacks, Murasaki-sensei sent it flying with gustoー
Launching it right into the swarm of mechanical ants.
The ants that were hit directly were crushed flat, and the surrounding ones got thrown against the walls by the resulting whirlwind and crumpled to the floor.
We were still overwhelmed after having witnessed the power of the "Immortal Taimanin" Yatsu Murasaki.
I thought I ordered you to bring back Kiryu Sabato?
Murasaki-sensei asked without dropping her strict expression.
I explained to Murasaki-sensei how we had ended up in this base.
So the deal you made to find out Kiryu Sabato's whereabouts was to infiltrate this base?
And why are you here, Murasaki-sensei?
One of the organizations of the UFS is using this place as a base to illegally acquire medical technology from the Devildom.
And it's suspected that several Japanese companies are involved in this. I'm here to get proof of this involvement.
Does that mean you were also after this data, Murasaki-sensei?
I took out the portable high-capacity storage device and showed it to her.
This is what Madam, the information broker, requested in exchange. I downloaded every last bit of data that was stored in this base.
Murasaki-sensei glanced at me and the data, a slightly surprised look on her face.
...It's true, I was after this data... but this "Madam" or whoever also wants it, right?
Yes. But I have a second set. I thought it might come in handy.
To be honest, it was because I wanted to have a look. Anyways, I had downloaded two sets of the data.
Y-You did what!? I was wondering why it was taking so long!! Because of that we almost weren't able to escape!!!!
In the end it was useful though.
The two of them glared at me with resentful eyes.
Isn't data like that easy to duplicate once you get your hands on it?
Yeah, no need to do something risky like that.
No, that most likely would've been impossible.
Usually this sort of data is encrypted to prevent if from being duplicated.
That's why you have to enter enemy territory and get it from there directly.
Getting two sets of data in a single break-in is quite an efficient result. Your captain did a good job.
Having Murasaki-sensei, who had the image of being a hard and strict teacher, smile at me like that left me uncharacteristically flustered.
A heavy metallic sound made me turn aroundー
The powered exoskeleton struggled to raise its crumpled body and turned to face us.
I see... looks like the pilot was just knocked out. It has a thicker shell than I expected.
And more unnerving crashing sounds came from further behind it. Most likely another group of mechanical ants was on the way.
Alright, we're done here! Let's get rid of them and withdraw!!
